def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is one file name with no directory parts, drive letters, or NUL bytes."""
    ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
    ex is_plain_name("/etc/passwd") == False
    ex is_plain_name("sub/a.txt") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    for c in name.chars():
        if c == "/" or c == "\\" or c == ":" or c == "\0":
            return False
    return True

def note_path(name: str) -> str:
    """Relative path of name inside the notes directory."""
    pre is_plain_name(name)
    ex note_path("a.txt") == "notes/a.txt"
    return "notes/" + name

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the file name inside notes, or "" when it is missing or unreadable."""
    pre is_plain_name(name)
    post out.char_count() >= 0
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        text = fs.read(name) else ""
        return text

def count_readable(names: list[str]) -> int uses fs:
    """Count the names whose file under notes reads as non-empty text.

    Each name is confined to the notes directory through fs.sub("notes"), and any
    name that is not a plain file name is skipped, so no name reaches a file outside notes.
    """
    post out >= 0
    post out <= names.len()
    count = 0
    for name in names:
        if not is_plain_name(name):
            continue
        if read_note(name) != "":
            count += 1
    return count
